Jacksonville & the Beaches

Find the house, not the listing

Dana Whitfield has closed more than four hundred homes across Duval and St Johns since 2011. She works with eight families at a time, which is why her clients get her mobile number.

What working with Dana looks like

Every search starts with a two hour sit down. We go through what you actually need, what you think you need, and what the market will let you have this quarter.

You will see houses before they list. Dana holds a standing Tuesday call with forty agents across Northeast Florida, and that is where most of her buyers find theirs.

Neighbourhoods we know street by street

  • Riverside and Avondale, including the historic districts
  • Atlantic Beach, Neptune Beach and Jacksonville Beach
  • Nocatee and the Ponte Vedra corridor
  • San Marco, Southside and the Baymeadows line

Recent sales

Fourteen closings in the last ninety days, at an average of eleven days on market against a county average of thirty four.
